raw.description:
Prelim is hiring our first dedicated recruiter. We're a profitable, remote-first company doubling revenue year over year, and hiring is now the constraint on growth. You'll learn to run full-cycle recruiting across engineering, sales, and implementations, trained by the people who built our recruiting process.

We’re looking for someone sharp, fast, and relentless about improving. Our interview loops, rubrics, and processes are already built — your job is to master them, run them, and eventually make them better than we could.

What you'll do

  • Run full-cycle recruiting: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and supporting offers through close

  • Fill pipelines with cold outreach, referrals, and events — not just process inbound applications

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand what “exceptional” looks like for each role

  • Help run campus recruiting efforts

  • Track pipeline metrics and report what’s working and what isn’t

  • Protect candidate experience — fast loops, honest communication, clean closes

What we're looking for

  • Clear communicator with strong writing skills: you’ll write JD’s, reports, debriefs, offer letters, and internal documentation

  • Genuine interest in people: reading them, persuading them, advocating for them

  • Output volume you can point to — a role where you handled high throughput (customers served, calls made, events run, tickets closed)

  • Evidence you learn hard things fast — what, how quickly, and what the result was

  • A track record of top-tier performance: early promotion, top ranking, a team you led, a business you started

  • Nice to have: any exposure to recruiting, sales, or fintech

About Prelim

Prelim is a San Francisco and New York City-based startup that operates with fully remote positions across the US, helping banks onboard their customers. Our platform is designed to streamline the account opening process for both consumers and businesses, accelerating speed-to-market and enhancing the customer experience for financial institutions. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the banking industry, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Prelim. We are seeking individuals who are driven, ambitious, and eager to make a real impact in a traditional industry ready for technological innovation.

We offer equity, a sponsored 401K, parental leave, and fully paid health, vision, and dental insurance. Additional benefits include unlimited PTO, a remote work stipend, a life-style stipend, and twice-yearly company offsites.

Prelim values diversity and inclusion; people of all backgrounds are welcome to join our mission to transform banking.

Compensation Range: $120K - $130K

POSITION SUMMARY
RP Florida, a Radiology Partners practice, is currently seeking board-certified or board-eligible General/Emergency Radiologists for flexible, remote 1099 opportunities. This position offers the freedom to work from home in a noncommittal, shift-based role. We are very flexible with our shift scheduling and have no minimum work-volume thresholds.
Position Highlights:
  • Flexible work model: Choose from full shifts (8-9 hours) or short shifts (4 hours). No minimum RVUs/work units are required. Choose your own shifts when it works best for you
  • Competitive compensation rates based on daytime, evening, or overnight shift times
  • Malpractice coverage provided, including tail coverage
  • Florida license required
  • Diverse case mix: Includes outpatient, ER, and inpatient reads
  • Licensure support: Dedicated credentialing specialists to streamline onboarding
  • Collaborative practice environment: Access to clinical and technical support

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RP Florida serves 8 HCA hospitals and multiple freestanding emergency rooms across the Greater Tampa region and Florida’s Gulf Coast. We provide expertise across all major radiology subspecialties, offering both on-site and remote reading services, along with a variety of procedural cases. Our team-based model fosters exceptional patient care through the strategic use of shared resources, state-of-the-art technology, and comprehensive support at both the national and local levels. By joining this team, you'll become a member of a well-supported, physician-led, and highly collegial group!

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Candidates must be a Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine and be residency trained in Diagnostic Radiology
  • Board-eligible or board-certified by the American Board of Radiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology
  • Medical license or the ability to obtain a license in the state of Florida

COMPENSATION:

The salary range for this position is $500,000 - $1,000,000. Final determinations may vary based on several factors, including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location, etc.

For More Information or to Apply:

For inquiries about this position, please contact Matthew McClellan at or 281-738-1785.

RADIOLOGY PARTNERS OVERVIEW

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.
Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe, and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion, and a healthy respect for differences.
Radiology Partners participates in E-verify.
CCPA Notice: When you submit a job application or resume, you are providing the Practice with the following categories of personal information that the Practice will use for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for employment: (1) Personal Identifiers; and (2) Education and Employment History.

Beware of Fraudulent Messages:

Radiology Partners will never request payment, banking, financial or personal information such as a driver’s license in exchange for interviews or as part of the hiring process. Additionally, we will not send checks for deposit into your bank account at any stage of recruitment. All communication during the interview and hiring process should come from an email address ending in “@radpartners.com.” If you suspect you are receiving a fraudulent job offer or solicitation from Radiology Partners or one of our local practices, please notify our Recruiting Team at .

raw.description:
We're looking for Junior and Senior Developers to join our fully remote team. If you like complexity and want your work to actually matter, you'll fit right in.

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. Our mission is to automate everything a property manager does.

What you'll do

You'll build with Claude and Cursor. What exactly you work on depends on where you land — our work splits roughly like this:

  • Product (Full-Stack). Work on the software property managers use all day. Help us improve what's there and push our roadmap forward by owning new features and refining them until they're as easy to use as the Uber app.

  • Integrations (Backend). Handle every way data gets into our platform. Email, phone calls (Twilio & Vonage), WhatsApp. The other half is moving customers off whatever they used before: Importing years of email, hundreds of thousands of documents, and every record on their buildings, apartments, contracts and contacts, plus syncing with systems a customer still runs alongside us.

  • Agents (Backend). Improve the agent platform behind with 200+ tools and a built-in knowledge base. Customers build and train their own agents in a sandbox or use agents we've already built for them. Both text and voice.

Our minimalistic tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Salary

  • $1000 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

You are:

  • fluent in English.

  • a seasoned developer with more than a year of experience shipping production code

  • a builder first. You'd rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship.

  • comfortable working autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks.

  • writing almost al of your code with AI.

  • performing even better when working under performance pressure.

  • quick to learn new things and consider yourself a generalist, not a specialist.

Your techstack:

is not important to us, since AI will be writing 100% of your code.

Nice to have:

  • Solid backend and systems-design experience – experience designing a database from the ground up (tables, relationships, indexes) and also with optimizing query performance & cost

raw.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The Associate Project Manager is a member of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE), responsible for managing operational and process improvement projects while supporting larger cross-functional initiatives. This role partners with business stakeholders and project sponsors to plan, coordinate, execute, and implement projects that drive operational effectiveness and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and results-oriented project professional who can independently manage projects, coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders, and contribute to larger cross-functional initiatives. This individual combines strong project management fundamentals with a hands-on approach to execution and continuous improvement.

Serving as a key point of coordination across Operations and cross-functional teams, this role helps drive project success through effective planning, communication, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Independently manage small to medium-sized operational, process improvement, and business projects from identification through implementation.
  • Support the senior manager and business leaders on larger, more complex cross-functional initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and project artifacts.
  • Define project scope, deliverables, schedules, and success measures for assigned projects.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, issues, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
  • Coordinate resources and stakeholders to ensure projects remain on track and objectives are achieved.
  • Facilitate problem resolution and escalate significant risks or issues when appropriate.
  • Support implementation activities and help ensure successful transition and adoption of project outcomes.
  • Maintain accountability for project deliverables, timelines, and commitments.

Execution & Project Support

  • Actively contributes to project execution activities to achieve business objectives and ensure successful delivery.
  • Prepare project deliverables, documentation, communications, presentations, enablement materials, and implementation plans.
  • Support teams in identifying and resolving operational challenges that may impact project scope, timelines, or business outcomes.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure action items are completed, decisions are documented, and commitments are fulfilled.
  • Apply a hands-on approach to delivery, helping teams translate plans into action and move initiatives efficiently from planning through execution.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and digital tools to streamline project processes, improve efficiency, and enhance delivery outcomes.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships across the organization to drive alignment, engagement, and execution.
  • Coordinate project activities across Operations, Product, IT, Finance, Sales, and other business functions.
  • Facilitate project meetings, working sessions, and stakeholder communications; support leadership reviews as needed.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned projects and initiatives.
  • Communicate project status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and priorities to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels to support project objectives, resolve issues, and drive successful outcomes.

Portfolio Management & Reporting

  • Manage multiple assigned projects simultaneously while balancing priorities, timelines, and stakeholder needs.
  • Prepare and maintain project status reports, project metrics, and support documentation.
  • Monitor project progress and identify risks, issues, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Follow established Procurement CoE project management standards, processes, and tools.
  • Provide project stakeholders and leadership with regular updates regarding milestones, timelines, and key deliverables.
  • Support resource coordination and project planning activities for assigned initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and action logs to support successful project execution.

Enablement, Continuous Improvement & Communication

  • Develop and maintain project templates, playbooks, standard work, and proven practices to drive consistency and execution excellence.
  • Partner with stakeholders to support communications, readiness activities, enablement, and adoption efforts.
  • Ensure stakeholders understand project objectives, timelines, impacts, decisions, and required actions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery and operational effectiveness through process optimization, automation, and digital solutions.
  • Utilize data, reporting, and AI-enabled tools to support project planning, performance monitoring, and informed decision-making.
  • Support and promote innovative ways of working that improve productivity, collaboration, and business outcomes.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, sharing, and implementing lessons learned across projects and initiatives.

KEY SKILLS –The ideal candidate for this role will excel in the following areas.

  • Execution Excellence – Drives disciplined execution, manages priorities and dependencies, and consistently delivers results.
  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes ownership of assigned projects and deliverables, proactively addresses challenges, and follows through to completion.
  • Project Management – Effectively plans, coordinates, and manages multiple initiatives, timelines, resources, risks, and dependencies.
  • Organization & Prioritization – Maintains structure across multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration – Builds trusted relationships, aligns diverse stakeholders, and drives cross-functional outcomes.
  • Change Management & Adoption – Supports organizational change by facilitating stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness activities, training, and adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Communication – Communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – Proactively identifies issues, evaluates potential impacts, and develops practical solutions to maintain project momentum.
  • Adaptability & Agility – Responds effectively to changing priorities, business needs, and project requirements while maintaining focus on results.
  • Continuous Improvement – Identifies opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and enhance project delivery through standardization, automation, and best practices.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience in project management, project coordination, PMO, business operations, or a related field.
  • Experience leading small projects independently and supporting medium to large cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project schedules, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and supporting projects through planning, execution, implementation, and adoption.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with project management and work management tools (Smartsheet preferred).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience supporting process improvement or change management initiatives preferred.
  • CAPM, project management coursework, Lean Six Sigma, or change management training preferred.
  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools to improve efficiency and project execution preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to occasionally travel for workshops or meetings.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

About Gordian

Gordian is the world’s leading provider of facility and construction cost data, software and services for all phases of the building lifecycle. A pioneer of Job Order Contracting (JOC), Gordian’s offerings also include our proprietary RSMeans data and Sightlines Facility Intelligence solutions. From planning to design, procurement, construction and operations, Gordian’s solutions help clients maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings and increase building quality. Gordian is a part of the international business group Fortive, with 26,000 people employed worldwide.We offer an excellent benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life and LTD insurance, HSA, and a 401(k) retirement plan. EOE/AA/M/F/Vets/Disabled.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at .

Bonus or Equity
This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.

The salary range for this position (in local currency) is 70,600.00 - 117,900.00

raw.description:
About the Role

Realty.com is hiring an Inbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) to support our growing inbound demand. This is a high-volume, structured role focused on qualifying inbound leads, having productive conversations, and setting high-quality demos for our sales team.

This role is not closing-focused and not full-cycle sales. Success is measured by consistency, follow-through, and execution.

If you enjoy talking to people, can stay disciplined in a repeatable daily workflow, and want to build a long-term career in sales, this role offers strong training, clear expectations, and a defined growth path.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond quickly to inbound leads via phone, text, and email

  • Have structured qualification conversations using the provided scripts

  • Identify customer intent and route leads appropriately

  • Set qualified demos for Account Executives

  • Track all activity accurately in our CRM

  • Follow daily call, activity, and quality standards

  • Stay focused, organized, and consistent throughout the day

This role involves a high volume of outbound calls to inbound leads. You will be on the phone daily.

What This Role Is (and Is Not)

This role is:

  • Inbound-only (no cold prospecting)

  • Process-driven and highly structured

  • Entry-level and training-focused

  • A stepping stone to more advanced sales roles

This role is not:

  • A closing or Account Executive position

  • Commission-only or high-ticket sales

  • A “build your own book” role

  • A fit for senior or full-cycle sales reps

Who We’re Looking For

  • Early-career candidates or recent graduates

  • Strong communicators who can stay calm and professional on the phone

  • People who are comfortable with repetition and routine

  • Coachable, reliable, and detail-oriented individuals

  • Prior sales experience is not required — training is provided

Compensation & Growth

  • Base salary with performance-based bonuses

  • Clear expectations and measurable success metrics

  • Opportunity to grow into advanced sales roles over time

Why Realty.com

Realty.com is a fast-growing real estate technology company focused on building scalable, data-driven sales systems. We value structure, clarity, and accountability, and we invest in people who want to grow within those systems.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Strong verbal communication skills and comfort speaking on the phone daily

  • Ability to follow scripts, processes, and daily activity expectations

  • High level of organization and attention to detail

  • Consistent work ethic and reliability

  • Coachable mindset and openness to feedback

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

  • Basic computer literacy and ability to learn CRM tools

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • Prior experience in sales, customer service, or call-center environments

  • Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)

  • Interest in pursuing a long-term career in sales

This Role Is a Strong Fit If You

  • Enjoy structured, repeatable work and clear expectations

  • Can handle rejection and stay focused throughout the day

  • Prefer being measured by effort and execution rather than guesswork

  • Want to build foundational sales skills before moving into a closing role

This Role Is Not a Fit If You

  • Are looking for a senior, closing, or full-cycle sales role

  • Dislike being on the phone for a large portion of the day

  • Need constant variety or unstructured work

  • Are primarily motivated by uncapped commissions or high-ticket deals

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • College coursework or degree is a plus but not required

Highlights

Inbound-only sales role focused on qualifying leads and setting demos. Entry-level, structured, phone-based position with clear training, performance metrics, and a defined path to grow in sales.

raw.description:
About MDOTM

MDOTM is a global leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, growing across our offices in London, Milan, and New York. We recently closed a $27M growth equity round, led by Expedition Growth Capital, to support our continued international expansion. Our proprietary platform, Sphere, currently supports over $100B in assets under management for institutional clients including Morgan Stanley, Amundi, and Zurich Bank.

Role Overview

MDOTM, a leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, is looking for an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Team. You will play a key role in supporting, enhancing, and maintaining the foundational infrastructure and tools that empower our product teams — contributing to a reliable, scalable, and efficient developer platform that enables fast and secure software delivery for Sphere, our proprietary AI-driven investment platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and automation of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases across all environments.
  • Assist in the adoption and management of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible, helping provision and manage on-premise and AWS resources in a controlled, auditable, and reproducible manner.
  • Work with Docker and Kubernetes to package and operate services, contributing to declarative configuration, GitOps practices, and efficient resource utilization.
  • Help implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix), and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and low Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).
  • Contribute to embedding security best practices (OWASP Top 10, least privilege IAM, shift-left testing) into the SDLC and help automate security controls within pipelines.
  • Support the management and automation of database infrastructure (MySQL, MongoDB), including provisioning, backups, and automated schema migrations.
  • Automate and support the deployment, scaling, and operational health of core platform services (authentication, data pipelines, messaging) for internal consumers.
  • Participate in technical design discussions, learn from architectural decisions related to infrastructure and operations, and help document runbooks and standards.
  • Champion DevOps culture ("you build it, you run it") and share knowledge through demos, pair programming, and internal workshops.

Skills Required

  • 1–3 years of professional experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role, with a focus on automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD
  • Hands-on experience working with and contributing to CI/CD pipelines
  • Practical experience with Docker and exposure to Kubernetes, including writing Dockerfiles and debugging containerized applications
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible
  • Experience with at least one monitoring, logging, or alerting system (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Zabbix), and curiosity for SRE principles
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating common tasks
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in the SDLC
  • Good analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting system and infrastructure issues
  • Clear English communication, collaborative spirit, and a growth mindset aligned with a culture of shared ownership and rapid feedback

Bonus points:

  • Experience with event-driven systems (e.g., ActiveMQ)
  • Contributions to open-source projects
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts (e.g., Java/Spring Boot)
  • Working knowledge of AWS fundamentals (EC2, S3, IAM)
  • Financial-services or high-throughput data processing background

Why Join Us?

  • Work at the leading edge of technology, leveraging our decade of experience in proprietary AI to power a platform trusted by top-tier institutional clients.
  • Truly flexible work environment — we care about output, not hours logged.
  • Collaborate daily with an ultra-international team (18+ nationalities) across our Milan, London, and New York offices.
  • Annual company retreat at a stunning location, because we invest in our people beyond the day job.
  • Real, fast-track career progression, with outsized growth opportunities for early team members.

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LCSW/LMFT/LMHC) 60K-75K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Billings, MT

Salary:

60K - 75K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Arizona is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and/or Colorado preferred.

OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $75,000 / year

raw.description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Thatch is rewiring how health benefits work. We build software that gives employees real control over how they use their benefits.

raw.description:
LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers. The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery.

This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset. You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives, serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution. You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts. The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models. In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization.

Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Delivery

  • Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
  • Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
  • Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
  • Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
  • Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
  • Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.

Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding

  • Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
  • Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
  • Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.

Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise

  • Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
  • Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:
    • Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
    • Partner margin and discount models.
    • Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
    • Usage and cost transparency.
    • Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation

  • Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
  • Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.

Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership

  • Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
  • Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
  • Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.

Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance

  • Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
  • Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
  • Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Qualifications

  • Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
  • Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
  • Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
  • Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
  • Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.
  • Strong product sense for turning messy operational problems into clear scope and shipped value with an excellent user experience.
  • Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
  • Coding experience is a plus—enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
  • Must have demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate product specifications and development.
  • Excellent communication skills: ability to engage deeply with partners, cloud experts, and internal stakeholders at the executive level.
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • You are universally recognized by your peers and leadership as the driving force and primary authority ("tip of the spear") for the Partner Platform's product direction.
  • Platform capabilities ship frequently with clear partner value.
  • Partner feedback loops are strong and visibly influence the overarching roadmap.
  • Adoption across the partner ecosystem increases and partner operational workflows improve measurably.
  • Billing accuracy, financial transparency, and operational scalability improve for partners using the platform.
  • Engineering teams consistently have clarity on the next most valuable increment to build—and why.
  • Other product owners on the team are effectively mentored, aligned, and elevated through your leadership.

Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

raw.description:
Are you ready to help reinvent primary care with a focus on lifestyle medicine and longevity? As Amenities Health’s Concierge Longevity Physician, you’ll not only deliver comprehensive primary care, but also actively shape the evolution of our premium concierge practice from day one. The focus of this clinical role is on a Concierge Longevity Program which includes elements of traditional primary care, time to build relationships with your patients, and time to focus on the latest in longevity assessments and treatments.

What you’ll do:

  • Deliver longitudinal, relationship-based care to a curated virtual panel (~1,000 members) — from preventive health and chronic conditions to complex care coordination, lifestyle medicine, root cause diagnosis, and advanced wellness.
  • Focus on modern longevity approaches based in lifestyle medicine with bandwidth to contemplate and advise patients on emerging pharmacological (e.g., GLP-1s, Category 1 Peptides) and non-pharmacological (e.g., red-light therapy, hot/cold plunges, hyperbaric) therapies.
  • Lead and contribute to the continued development of digital workflows, messaging norms, scheduling design, white-glove service protocols, and advanced clinical offerings.
  • Serve as a clinical voice in shaping practice culture, communication standards, and patient engagement—in a nimble, highly-motivated startup where your ideas directly impact care delivery.
  • Enjoy protected time for same-day urgent care, in-depth consults (50-min new appointments, 25-min follow-ups), and flexible administrative blocks—with zero legacy headaches or RVU churn.

What Makes This Role Different

  • Your panel, your pace: focus on quality of relationships, not volume of visits.
  • You’ll help build; not just participate. From EMR customizations to new service lines and wellness offerings, your clinical feedback directly drives our growth.
  • Join a company at the intersection of primary care, concierge medicine, longevity, AI-supported virtual care, and premium member services.
  • No maneuvering long clinic hallways, no “surprise” overbooks—just fully remote, modern, and optimized care that acknowledges that the best patient loyalty comes from physician loyalty.
  • As a direct (cash-pay) model, insurance billing workflows will not be a part of the physician’s role, giving you more time to focus on excellent patient care

We Offer

  • 100% remote, flexibly scheduled position (standard hours at launch, with future options to customize your week)
  • Panel capped at 1,000 for deep relationships—with full team support, modern EMR, and administrative help
  • The resources of major partner institutions (i.e., a robust referral network to supplement your care leadership)
  • 100% company-paid health insurance for you and/or family
  • A 401K program
  • PTO package, monthly wellness days, and annual off-sites
  • A mix of base annual salary and performance bonus for total cash compensation
  • Generous stock options: true ownership in our collective future

Requirements:

  • US board-certified MD/DO in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine
  • 3+ years in outpatient practice experience
  • Active medical license (or eligibility)
  • A service-oriented approach to patient care (i.e., a willingness, patience and joy in engaging patients, at their level, on their questions and interests)
  • A willingness to engage and stay up-to-date on topics like longevity, advanced testing, wearable data and monitoring, mental health, women's/men's health, and more

Preferred / Plus:

  • A social media presence, including LinkedIn, X, Instagram, etc.
  • Medical license in current and expansion states (NC, TX, CA, IN) or multi-state licensure
  • Experience in virtual care and/or concierge, DPC, or membership-based models
  • Strong track record of delivering outstanding patient experience and clinical excellence
  • An openness to new care frameworks and innovations and a commitment to comprehensive service to the patient
  • Comfort and curiosity with the latest in health tech: AI documentation, wearables, advanced diagnostics, lifestyle medicine, longevity, root-cause approaches
  • Commitment to collaborating, iterating, and building a better model—not just working in the old one

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Amenities Health is on a mission to build lasting loyalty in healthcare through our white-labeled concierge membership services for leading health systems. We believe that physicians sit at the center of that experience, and our model is designed to give them the time, tools, and operational support they need to deliver exceptional, relationship-driven care.

Founded by a physician executive with deep experience in major health systems and consumer-facing healthcare innovation, Amenities Health blends technology, care services, and clinical operations to create a best-in-class, scalable concierge care experience. Our virtual-first, membership-based model pairs market-leading digital infrastructure with a high-touch service approach, enabling physicians to build trusted, long-term relationships with a thoughtfully capped panel of patients.

As we scale with some of the country’s top healthcare brands, we’re setting a new standard for what modern longevity care can feel like - for patients, for physicians, and for the systems that support them. We invite clinicians who value time, connection, and care excellence to help us shape the future of concierge care. Unlike most technology companies who are trying to increase panel sizes, we’re capping them at 1,000. We believe that, with enough time, physicians can and should develop loyal, trusted relationships with their patients… which is an excellent business strategy.

raw.description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

  • Commitment to evidence-based medicine
  • Willingness to learn how to diagnose and treat a variety of adult/primary care conditions

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice.
